This helicopter trip around the island exceeded my expectations and was definitely an unforgettable journey! From beginning to end, every detail is very careful, so that you feel the professionalism and enthusiasm of the service.

Looking at the beautiful coastline, mountains and the colourful views of the sea, it is truly an unparalleled visual enjoyment!

One of the highlights of this trip is the magnificent natural landscapes, such as clear sea water, rugged valleys, and picturesque small villages, the whole process as if in a movie scene! We were also fortunate to see a group of dolphins swimming over the sea in the air, which was an unexpected surprise!

In addition, the service team is very attentive to detail, not only providing a comfortable headset for us to listen to the talk, but also carefully arranged a photo service to help us record the beauty of each moment.

In conclusion, this is a rewarding experience! Whether you want to experience an exciting flight or simply enjoy the spectacular scenery, this trip is highly recommended. If there is a chance, I will definitely participate again!

Review Text: If I could leave more than 5 stars I would.  From booking to landing, Captain Eric delivered a red carpet experience filled with aloha spirit. Review Text: My husband, adult son and I took the Maui Circle island Air Tour with Eric last week and thoroughly enjoyed every minute.  Eric is a seasoned pilot and his number one concern is that you have a great time.  He is also all about safety.  We definitely had a great time.  We saw a lot of beautiful scenery.  The plane holds three guests comfortably.  The person in the front seat next to the pilot gets to assist in the takeoff.  This person should be the designated picture taker as there is a convenient open section of the window that allows unobstructed picture taking.  Don't get too caught up in the picture taking or else you will miss some lovely spots.  You will definitely get low enough to enjoy beautiful waterfalls and landscape.  Don't pass this opportunity up.
